newsitem.title: USA: Gables Q4 shr $0.33 vs $0.27 with charge.
newsitem.headline: Gables Q4 shr $0.33 vs $0.27 with charge.

text.p: (Unaudited and amounts in thousands, except for per share
For the three months ended For the year ended

Note: Extraordinary loss, net for the year ended Dec 31, 1996 represents Gables Residential Trust'ss write-off of unamortized deferred financing costs associated with the March 1996 refinancing of the Company's original credit facility that was scheduled to mature in January 1997. The company closed on a new $175 million unsecured revolving credit facility. The extraordinary loss totaling $631,000 is presented net of the $111,000 portion of the loss attributable to the minority interest unitholders in the Operating Partnership.

Extraordinary loss for the three months and the year ended Dec 31, 1995, represents the write-off of unamortized deferred financing costs associated with the early retirement of the Company's construction loans with proceeds from an offering of common shares closed in October 1995 and a permanent financing closed in December, 1995. The extraordinary loss totaling $955,000 is presented net of the $171,000 portion of the loss attributable to the minority interest unitholders in the Operating Partnership.
